item.title: CVE-2026-19707 · 9.5 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Heap out-of-bounds write in the Smart Form Protection HTML entity decoder
item.description: A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0) allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack agains…
